Final Fantasy 14: How to Unlock Occult Crescent North Horn
items.summary: Read ahead for how to unlock Occult Crescent North Horn in Final Fantasy 14 along with all rewards.
items.content:
By Stephanie Watel Published Jul 28, 2026, 7:20 PM EDT Stephanie Watel is a Contributing Writer at DualShockers who has been covering games professionally since 2022. She specializes in guides and reviews, with additional experience writing lists and features across RPGs, horror games, cozy sims, action games, open-world RPGs, JRPGs, and indie titles.

Before joining DualShockers, Stephanie contributed to GameRant , IGN , MovieWeb , Pro Game Guides , Twinfinite , and Prima Games . Her work has covered major releases, underground sleeper hits, and indie games across a wide range of genres. Stephanie holds a B.A. in English , including studies in journalism.

Generate a summary of this story Jump links Jump Links How to Unlock Occult Crescent: North Horn How to Travel to Occult Crescent: North Horn Occult Crescent: North Horn Rewards Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap The Patch 7.55 update in Final Fantasy 14 brings with it a variety of new content for players to dive into, as the Dawntrail expansion truly begins to wind down and the buzz around Evercold continues to (ironically) heat up. Along with updates to Phantom Weapons, the Solution 9 leg of the ever-going Hildibrand questline, and the finale of the Allied Society questline, the Occult Crescent has finally gotten its next major region for players to explore.

If you're eager to make your return to the Occult Crescent, here's how to unlock the North Horn region, including all quests involved, as well as some of the valuable rewards you can earn during your adventures in the area.

The time has come to discover the franchise of the crystals.

The second major region of the Occult Crescent Field Operations content, North Horn, was added as part of the game's Patch 7.55 update. Before anything else, note that you'll need to have unlocked the South Horn region first, and completed its storyline up through the ' Mysteries Abide ' blue quest.

Once that's situated, make your way to Tuliyollal and speak to the Expedition Messenger at (X :17.2, Y:11.8 ) to pick up the 'Occult Reunion' quest . You must have a Level 100 combat class (Disciple of War or Magic) equipped to do so. Follow the objectives of the quest to the Phantom Village, and speak to the blue-garbed Roegadyn named Ketenramm near the fountain at ( X:6.1, Y:6.5 ).

Next, speak to Jeffroy, the Expedition Coordinator up the stairs to the north at (X:4.5, Y:6.5) to finish the quest and officially unlock the North Horn as an accessible area.

To travel to the North Horn area of the Occult Crescent, simply speak to Jeffroy, the Expedition Coordinator at ( X:4.5, Y:6.5 ) in the Phantom Village, and a list of available options will pop up for him. Select the 'North Horn' option near the top, and you'll then be placed into a queue for an instance of the region.

Once there, you can get yourself familiarized with the base camp and the NPCs there who can help you with various things. You'll also find Ketenramm, Archive, and Iris to continue the North Horn's storyline.

Other important NPCs to make note of here include the Expedition Supplier ( X:39.0, Y:38.6 ) who offers basic supplies for sale and can repair your gear, along with the Expedition Trader nearby to the right, who can exchange extra Soul Shards you have on hand.

Meanwhile, the Expedition Antiquarian nearby to the right ( X:39.5, Y:38.7 ) sells a diverse variety of rewards in exchange for Silver and Gold Obol tokens. You can pick up sets of ilvl 780 gear with inherent buffs specifically for the Occult Crescent, along with other rewards such as glamour sets, minions, furnishings, Soul Shards for unlocking more Phantom Jobs, Orchestion Rolls, and more.

The Expedition Antiquarian at the Base Camp in the North Horn is your main hub for reward exchanges. As you earn Gold and Silver Obol tokens from your adventures in the region, you can exchange them with her for a variety of valuable rewards, some of which you can keep or turn around and sell on the Market Board for substantial gil.

While some of the rewards are more miscellaneous in nature (e.g. — Materia), there are certain ones you'll want to make note of.

items.title: New FFXIV Twitch Support-a-Streamer Mount Is a Unicorn
items.summary: The FFXIV Twitch Support-a-Streamer promotion is back and this time Alsvid the unicorn mount is the reward.
items.content:
Square Enix announced a new Twitch Support-a-Streamer FFXIV promotion that gives players a chance to buy and gift qualifying subscriptions in order to earn an Alsvid Whistle to summon a new rainbow unicorn mount. It kicked off on July 28, 2026. People will have until August 25, 2026 to earn the Mog Station code for the item, and they need to have an active account to redeem the code.

The Twitch promotion only applies to streams in the FFXIV category on the service and Affiliate and Partner channels streaming the game while that stream is set to the correct category. You then need to buy three subscriptions. These can be tier 1, 2, or 3 ones that you either get for yourself or choose to gift.

After you buy the three applicable subscriptions, you will get the FFXIV Alsvid unicorn mount code in your Twitch Notifications Inbox. Only one code can be earned per promotion. Said Item Code can be redeemed in Mog Station in Registration Codes.

To go along with the reveal, Square Enix also shared two in-game screenshots of the mount being used.

This sort of FFXIV Twitch Support-a-Streamer promotion happened before. In 2024, it ended up being the way to get the Snowstreamer Snowman mount.

Final Fantasy XIV is on the PS4, PS5, Xbox Series X, and PC now, comes to the Switch 2 on August 4, 2026, and FFXIV Evercold will appear in January 2027. The FFXIV Twitch Support-a-Streamer Alsvid the unicorn mount promotion will run between July 28, 2026 and August 25, 2026.

Final Fantasy XIV Launches on Nintendo Switch 2 Next Week, Requiring 117.2 GB of Storage
items.summary: Final Fantasy 14 launches on Switch 2 on August 4 with a 117.2 GB file size. Learn about storage needs, microSD Express support and setup checks.
items.content:
Final Fantasy 14 launches on Switch 2 on August 4 with a 117.2 GB file size. Learn about storage needs, microSD Express support and setup checks.

Final Fantasy XIV is finally heading to Nintendo Switch 2 next week , but players may need to clear some serious storage space before entering Eorzea.

Square Enix will release Final Fantasy XIV for Nintendo Switch 2 on August 4, giving players another portable way to access its enormous MMORPG. As spotted on the US eShop , the Switch 2 version comes with a hefty 117.2 GB storage requirement.

That is not a minor download by handheld standards. Nintendo Switch 2 includes 256 GB of internal storage, meaning Final Fantasy XIV alone could occupy nearly half of its total advertised capacity. The system software and any games already installed will reduce the space actually available to players, making the practical situation even tighter.

In other words, you may want to begin cleaning out that backlog now.

Nintendo Switch 2 supports microSD Express cards for expanded game storage, and Final Fantasy XIV is exactly the sort of release that makes one worth considering. A 117.2 GB installation leaves considerably less room for other large games, downloadable content, screenshots, and future updates.

Players should also remember that live-service games rarely remain the same size forever. Final Fantasy XIV regularly receives patches, seasonal content, balance adjustments, and major expansions. Its Switch 2 storage footprint could therefore change after launch, even if 117.2 GB is enough for the initial installation.

Standard microSD cards used with the original Switch cannot store and run Switch 2 software. Anyone purchasing additional storage specifically for Final Fantasy XIV should make sure the card uses the microSD Express standard.

Final Fantasy XIV launches on Switch 2 in 4 editions.

The Switch 2 port is still a major step for the game. Portable access could make crafting, gathering, daily activities, and shorter questing sessions more convenient, provided the version delivers stable performance and readable interface scaling.

Final Fantasy XIV launches on Switch 2 next week.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14 Will Be The Nintendo Switch 2's Biggest Game by Install Size
items.summary: Square Enix MMO Final Fantasy 14 will land on Switch 2 with an almighty thud next month, as its honking install size will take up almost half of the console's 256GB memory.
items.content:
Square Enix MMO Final Fantasy 14 will land on Switch 2 with an almighty thud next month, as its honking install size will take up almost half of the console's 256GB memory.

Final Fantasy 14 will weigh in at 117.2GB when it launches for Switch 2 on August 4, an eShop listing for the title has now revealed. Here's hoping you have space for it — or the budget to buy a new SD card.

That's around double the game's install size on PlayStation 5, which benefits from some clever file compression technology, though similar to the game's memory footprint on PC. It's a hefty download, though perhaps to be expected when you consider the MMO's size and the amount of content that has been added over the years.

The upside to all this is that the filesize includes all of the game's previous five expansions — Heavensward, Stormblood, Shadowbringers, Endwalker and Dawntrail — so you won't need more space to play any of those. The downside? A sixth expansion, Evercold, is already on the way — meaning you'll likely need even more memory space from next January.

Somewhat amusingly, Final Fantasy publisher Square Enix is no stranger to holding the record for the biggest Switch 2 games by memory size. Until the launch of Final Fantasy 14, Square Enix's Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth holds the current record (91.8GB) for a single game, as well as the record for a game bundle (the Kingdom Hearts Collection, which includes a trio of titles that weigh in at 131GB total).

Final Fantasy 14 game director Naoki Yoshida suited up in Bastion armor to take the stage at Final Fantasy 14 Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin to confirm the title's long-awaited Switch 2 launch date over the weekend, alongside a laundry list of new updates coming in the near future . The game's first month on sale will be offered without any subscription charge as its servers are stabilized. After this period comes to an end, players will be required to purchase a subscription as normal.

Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

items.title: Wisdom of Nym: Reactions to Final Fantasy XIV’s second fan festival
Final Fantasy 14 comes to Switch 2 later this year with the now-famous free trial, but the file size is going to be absolutely massive
items.summary: Evercold, the next FF14 expansion, is coming in early 2027, but Square Enix is making a splash this summer with a Switch 2 port of the MMO.
items.content:
Image credit: Eurogamer / Square Enix / Nintendo News by Fran Ruiz Contributor Published on July 27, 2026 7 comments Follow Final Fantasy XIV: Online One of this year's most surprising Nintendo Switch 2 port announcements was Final Fantasy 14's back in April , and against all expectations, it was set to arrive in August. Now we know it's right around the corner, and the Evercold expansion has received a big teaser trailer, too.

During the Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin , a five-minute 'extended teaser trailer' that sets the stage for the MMORPG's next chapter - the start of the Godless Realms Saga story arc - was shown alongside plenty of fresh details. Perhaps the most important one was the reveal of the Bastion , a new tank class "that wields a pair of greatshields known as skyltborg".

Pre-orders for the Switch 2 version of the game, which is confirmed to launch on 4th August, were also opened. As a reminder, the ambitious port will require a separate monthly sub from the other versions of the game even if you're using the same account, but it won't require the usual Nintendo Switch Online membership that online games typically ask for. Those willing to pay two different FF14 subs will get a 50 percent discount on the Switch 2 one, though.

The better news is that FF14 on Switch 2 will also have the popular free trial - which includes quite a bit of content - in order to entice players who are on the fence. That said, anyone who's looking to jump into the MMO on Nintendo's hybrid console will need to liberate - according to the US eShop - 117.2 GB at launch. It'll no doubt be one of Switch 2's largest games, but if we look at FF7 Remake and Rebirth hovering around 90 GB, it seems more than reasonable for a massive MMO with a ridiculous amount of content.

Other Final Fantasy 14 reveals that came this past weekend include an Evangelion 'Ghosts of Desire' collaboration, the announcement of a new data centre system for improved connectivity and same-region player matching, and a planned crossover with the FF7 Remake trilogy .

items.content:
In the hope that would-be adventurers can experience all that FFXIV has to offer, we are pleased to announce the latest Free Login Campaign. Follow the Trail to the Heavens! In Patch 7.5, you can face Enuo in the Unmaking, take a stroll through Windurst: The Third Walk in the FINAL FANTASY XI alliance raid crossover, and leap into battle in Archeia Harmonias, an all-new arena for Crystalline Conflict. A host of other additions and adjustments will make your time in Eorzea more streamlined and enjoyable, including increased furnishing placement limits, the consolidation of dyes, and additional pieces of gear that can now be converted to outfit glamour or stored in the armoire. With the introduction of Patch 7.5, the Shadowbringers expansion can now be played as part of the FINAL FANTASY XIV Starter Edition. The expansion will be automatically registered to your account if you already own the Starter Edition, so why not take this opportunity to jump into the adventure?

If you or any of your friends are currently taking a break from your adventures, you won't want to miss out on this limited-time event! Visit the Free Login Campaign website for details.
